verdicts.reason: Both are nearly the same broken banner: the three steps are shrunk to unreadable micro-text, scattered and out of order (03 at top, then 01, then 02), the CTA pill butts directly against the headline's left edge, the eyebrow is tiny and stranded, and the bag runs off the bottom. A wins only on its balanced headline wrap ('Three steps to a / better cup'); B leaves an orphaned 'cup'.

A puts the steps in order across the top but at illegible size, the CTA collides with the headline, and the eyebrow is demoted to sit beside the logo under the headline. B reads left to right (bag, headline, CTA at the end) with no CTA collision, but its steps are illegible fragments scattered around the CTA out of order, the headline orphans 'cup', and the bag is cropped.

A has a clean bag–headline–CTA flow, a balanced headline wrap and an uncropped bag, but its steps are unreadable specks scattered above, below and beside the CTA, out of sequence. B keeps the steps in order across the top but just as illegible, orphans 'cup' on the second headline line, pushes the bag to the canvas edge and moves the eyebrow under the headline.
